description: Header file defining functions and structures for model compatibility checks in PyTorch JIT mobile, including version retrieval, operator info, contained types, and compatibility validation.

classes.name: ModelCompatibilityInfo
classes.description: Structure holding model version, operator info, contained types, and methods to retrieve this info.

classes.name: ModelCompatibilityStatus
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the compatibility check result status.

classes.name: ModelCompatCheckResult
classes.description: Structure representing the result of a compatibility check, including status and errors.

methods.name: _get_model_bytecode_version
methods.description: Retrieve model bytecode version from stream, filename, or ReadAdapterInterface.

methods.name: _get_model_operator_version
methods.description: Retrieve model operator version from stream, filename, or ReadAdapterInterface.

methods.name: get_bytecode_ivalues
methods.description: Extract bytecode IValues from a PyTorchStreamReader.

methods.name: readArchive
methods.description: Read and extract data from an archive using a stream reader.

methods.name: check_zip_file
methods.description: Check if a zip file is valid using a ReadAdapterInterface.

methods.name: _get_model_ops_and_info
methods.description: Get operator information and root ops from a model stream, filename, or ReadAdapterInterface.

methods.name: _get_mobile_model_contained_types
methods.description: Get contained types from a model stream, filename, or bytecode values.

methods.name: ModelCompatibilityInfo::get
methods.description: Factory methods to create ModelCompatibilityInfo from stream, filename, or ReadAdapterInterface.

methods.name: is_compatible
methods.description: Check if runtime info and model info are compatible.
